dimension_note: Wheelbase 3.10 m and overall width 1.66 m are sourced (Wikipedia; Classic & Sports Car). Track, 0.38 m wheels on 55 mm tyres, the sill spacing and all heights are assumptions. The hull's sills end 0.4 m behind the front wheels (they steer 30 deg); narrower front horns carry the pillars and radiator.
suspension_note: Front: each wheel carrier slides on a fixed pillar (kingpin) between the hull's upper and lower arms, with a coil spring above the carrier; the hydraulic damper inside the pillar is not drawn (joint damping stands in for it). Rear: live axle on semi-elliptic springs; the friction dampers are dry friction on the axle's heave joint.
steering_note: Steering box behind the front cross member on the right (the column is raked back to a wheel on the right: right-hand drive), pitman and drag arms equal and parallel (a parallelogram, 1:1), and the drag link crossing under the engine to the left knuckle. With the pillars' vertical travel, the link's end moves inboard only by dz^2/2L, so bump steer is second order (about 0.6 deg at full travel). A first layout with a lengthwise link and a non-parallel drag arm gave 1.6:1 steering and 2.5 deg of bump steer.
